evals.prompt: I feel like I keep asking Claude Code and Codex to do the same stuff over and over — reviews, commit routines, daily checks. Can you go through my actual session history (~/.claude/projects and ~/.codex/sessions) and figure out what I should turn into automated loops? Give me a ranked report I can act on.
evals.expected_output: A ranked loop-opportunities report grounded in real transcript evidence (frequencies, dates, quoted prompts), with proposed mechanism per item and cost cautions; produced without reading raw gigabyte logs.

evals.prompt: Set up an automated loop for this project: every weekday morning, check for failing tests and any TODO/FIXME comments that have been sitting around, and write me a short brief. It must not run away with tokens — give it hard limits. I'm not around to answer questions, so make sensible choices and write down your assumptions. Don't actually start any scheduler — just set everything up ready to go.
evals.expected_output: A complete loop scaffold: spec with machine-verifiable stop condition, numeric budget, escalation rules, idempotency notes; a state/memory file wired read-first/write-last; a registry entry; and the exact ready-to-run start command.

evals.prompt: I've got some loops set up in this project — how are they doing? Anything stale or waiting on me? Give me a status rundown and what you'd recommend, written to STATUS.md in the project root.
evals.expected_output: Status table covering both registered loops; deps-audit flagged stale/broken (last run 2026-04-20, weekly cadence); unregistered old-experiment folder caught as drift; findings inbox surfaced (lodash vuln + eslint migration); retire/tune/fix recommendations.

evals.prompt: Every time i change this app I manually run npm test, then open index.html and click the + button to make sure the counter goes up with no console errors. Can you set things up so the agent does this check automatically after changes instead of me? Don't refactor the app itself.
evals.expected_output: A verification skill encoding the manual steps (npm test + browser click-through + console check) with evidence capture and a proactive trigger description, plus regression-scope checks beyond the literal steps; app source unchanged.
